name: Detección de Lenguaje Hedging
description: Detecta patrones of cobertura and epistemic markers en texto, as AI tends to use excessive cautious language and qualifiers.
useCase: Identifying generado por IA text through overuse of uncertainty markers and safety qualifiers
mechanism: Identifica cobertura expressions (modal verbs: 'might', 'could', 'may'; adverbs: 'potentially', 'possibly', 'arguably'; phrases: 'it is worth noting', 'it should be mentioned') and computes their frequency relative to assertive language. AI systems, especially instruction-tuned models, systematically overuse cobertura to appear balanced and avoid making definitive claims, creating a measurable estadístico signature.
source: Liang, W. et al. (2024) - Mapping the Increasing Use of LLMs in Scientific Papers, arXiv
algorithm: Hedging Lexicon Matching + Assertiveness Ratio + Modal Verb Frequency Analysis
parameters: Hedge lexicon: 200+ expressions, Categories: epistemic/approximative/plausibility shields, Ratio: hedge-to-assertion, Normalization: per 100 words
strengths:
• Captura un sesgo sistemático conocido de los LLM ajustados por instrucciones
• Funciona bien en texto académico y profesional
• Bajo costo computacional
• Resultados fáciles de interpretar
limitations:
• Scientific writing naturally contains cobertura
• Cultural differences affect cobertura norms
• Base models hedge less than RLHF-tuned ones
• Simple paraphrasing can remove cobertura

references.title: Liang, W. et al. (2024). Mapping the Increasing Use of LLMs in Scientific Papers. arXiv.
Hyland, K. (2005). Metadiscourse: Exploring Interaction in Writing. Continuum.
Kobak, D. et al. (2024). Delving into ChatGPT Usage in Academic Writing Through Excess Vocabulary. arXiv.
